platform: Without Warning Radio Broadcast-Quality Music Submission Email Opportunity
manual_review_reason: Without Warning Radio's official Music Submissions page accepts new music at submissions@withoutwarningradio.com and requires constant 320 Kbps MP3 audio, embedded artist/title/version metadata, album or single artwork, social-media details and booking or management information. A human must select a suitable track, verify the exact master and metadata, confirm attachment-size and track-count limits, international eligibility, explicit-content handling, rights, release timing and AI-origin policy, then send manually. Newsletter, request-line, app, social and general content routes must not be used as substitutes.
